story_timeline: 8月31日伦敦：邦德丧妻八个月后精神崩溃，M派他去日本索取MAGIC44；9月初邦德抵达东京，会见田中虎并凭记忆传回苏联200兆吨核武器密电；9月20日苏联核试验如期举行；9月下旬田中提出交易，邦德化装成日本渔民工人，经鸟羽、京都、别府受训后抵达福冈，认出萨特汉就是布洛菲尔德；10月满月夜邦德住进黑岛，与喜悦子潜水采鲍鱼三日后夜游潜入死亡城堡，次夜被俘受审，当夜扼死布洛菲尔德、炸毁城堡、坠海失忆；伦敦发表讣告推定邦德死亡；冬季至次年春邦德以塔罗·托多罗基的身份在黑岛生活，喜悦子怀孕；次年春邦德因符拉迪沃斯托克一词触动记忆，离岛北上寻回过去，全书终结时他仍不知道自己名叫詹姆斯·邦德

chapters.summary: 东京艺妓晚宴上，邦德与田中虎玩剪刀石头布并获胜，田中邀他回家密谈，暗示有极机密之事相商
chapters.title: SCISSORS CUT PAPER
chapters.summary_en: At a geisha dinner in Tokyo, Bond beats Tiger Tanaka at scissors-paper-stone; Tanaka invites him home for a nightcap and hints at a matter of the highest secrecy.

chapters.summary: 倒叙一个月前伦敦：邦德丧妻八个月后精神崩溃，酗酒、赌博、工作失误，M本想让他退役，神经学家莫洛尼建议给他一个看似不可能的重要任务
chapters.title: CURTAINS FOR BOND?
chapters.summary_en: Flashback to London a month earlier: eight months after Tracy's death, Bond is drinking, gambling and bungling his work; M is ready to retire him until the neurologist Sir James Molony urges giving him one apparently impossible, vital assignment.

chapters.summary: M给邦德代理晋升外交部门，派他去日本从田中虎手中取得苏联密码破译成果MAGIC44，邦德以澳大利亚外交官身份出发
chapters.title: THE IMPOSSIBLE MISSION
chapters.summary_en: M gives Bond an acting promotion to the Diplomatic Section and sends him to Japan to obtain MAGIC 44, the Japanese decryption of Soviet traffic, from Tiger Tanaka; Bond travels under Australian diplomatic cover.

chapters.summary: 邦德抵达东京羽田机场，澳大利亚情报官迪科·亨德森接机，两人在银座梅洛迪酒吧发现被田中窃听，迪科讲解日本的恩义与面子观念
chapters.title: DIKKO ON THE GINZA
chapters.summary_en: Bond lands at Tokyo's Haneda Airport, where the Australian intelligence officer Dikko Henderson meets him; in the Melody Bar on the Ginza they find Tanaka has bugged their table, and Dikko explains Japanese ideas of obligation and face.

chapters.summary: 邦德首次会见田中虎，田中在地下旧地铁站办公室向他展示一份MAGIC44破译的苏联密电，内容是苏联200兆吨核武器试验与讹诈英国的计划，田中暗示邦德应把内容传回伦敦
chapters.title: MAGIC 44
chapters.summary_en: Bond meets Tiger Tanaka, whose office lies in a disused underground station; Tanaka shows him a MAGIC 44 decrypt of a Soviet message about a 200-megaton weapon test and a plan to blackmail Britain, and hints that Bond should pass its contents to London.

chapters.summary: 一个月后邦德与田中成为朋友，田中透露日本已渗透英国的澳门蓝色通道情报网，艺妓晚宴后田中向邦德讲述收集死亡的瑞士植物学家萨特汉博士
chapters.title: TIGER, TIGER!
chapters.summary_en: A month later Bond and Tanaka are friends; Tanaka reveals that Japan has already penetrated Britain's Macao Blue Route network, and after the geisha dinner tells Bond about Dr Shatterhand, the collector of death.

chapters.summary: 田中详述萨特汉博士夫妇1月入境日本，在九州建毒花园、雇佣黑龙会余党为守卫，半年内已有500多人来此自杀，并出示农业部毒植物清单
chapters.title: THE DEATH COLLECTOR
chapters.summary_en: Tanaka describes how Dr Shatterhand and his wife entered Japan in January, built a poison garden in Kyushu, hired former Black Dragon men as guards, and drew more than five hundred suicides within six months, showing Bond the agriculture ministry's list of poison plants.

chapters.summary: 田中讲述日本自杀文化与死亡城堡的吸引力，其派去调查的特工被折磨致死，临死只念写蜻蜓的俳句，最后提出交易：邦德潜入死亡城堡杀死城堡主人，换取MAGIC44
chapters.title: SLAY IT WITH FLOWERS
chapters.summary_en: Tanaka explains Japanese attitudes to suicide and the castle's pull, tells how his agent sent to investigate was tortured to death and died murmuring a haiku about dragonflies, then proposes the bargain: Bond will enter the Castle of Death and kill its master in exchange for MAGIC 44.

chapters.summary: 邦德在澡堂接受染肤、理发等化装，扮成日本人，化名聋哑煤矿工人，田中带他乘火车与水翼船去鸟羽，讲述自己神风特攻队的往事
chapters.title: INSTANT JAPAN
chapters.summary_en: Bond is made up in a bath-house - skin dyed, hair cut - to pass as a Japanese, under the name of Taro Todoroki, a deaf-mute coalminer from Fukuoka; Tanaka takes him by train and hydrofoil to Toba and tells him of his own kamikaze training.

chapters.summary: 田中带邦德参观伊势神宫、品尝神户牛肉、观看忍者训练学校演示，途中发现有人骑摩托跟踪
chapters.title: ADVANCED STUDIES
chapters.summary_en: Tanaka shows Bond the shrine of Ise, Kobe beef and a ninjutsu training school, where a pupil falls into the moat and drowns; on the way they notice a motorcyclist tailing them.

chapters.summary: 京都与濑户内海之行：参观日本最古老妓院、乘船去别府、听田中讲解俳句与相扑手的护身术、吃河豚宴，跟踪者再次出现
chapters.title: ANATOMY CLASS
chapters.summary_en: The tour continues through Kyoto and across the Inland Sea: Japan's oldest brothel, the voyage to Beppu, lessons in haiku and sumo, and a fugu dinner, with the tail appearing again.

chapters.summary: 去福冈途中邦德识破并截获跟踪的黑龙会特工，对方被警察刺死，邦德在安藤警视处看死亡城堡航拍图，认出萨特汉博士就是布洛菲尔德、其妻就是艾玛·布朗特，决定隐瞒身份、私自复仇
chapters.title: APPOINTMENT IN SAMARA
chapters.summary_en: On the way to Fukuoka, Bond traps the Black Dragon agent tailing them; the man is killed by a policeman, and at Superintendent Ando's office Bond sees aerial photographs and recognises Dr Shatterhand as Blofeld and his wife as Irma Bunt - and decides to keep it secret and take his revenge himself.

chapters.summary: 邦德乘警察快艇抵达黑岛，住进阿妈族渔家铃木家，认识潜水女郎喜悦子，化名塔罗·托多罗基，田中赠送自杀药丸被邦德拒绝
chapters.title: KISSY SUZUKI
chapters.summary_en: Bond reaches Kuro Island by police launch and lodges with the ama family of the Suzukis, meeting the diver Kissy Suzuki; Tanaka's parting gift, a suicide pill, is refused.

chapters.summary: 邦德与喜悦子出海潜水采鲍鱼，认识鸬鹚大卫，一天收获65只鲍鱼，邦德萌生与喜悦子共度余生的念头
chapters.title: ONE GOLDEN DAY
chapters.summary_en: Bond dives for abalone with Kissy, meets her cormorant David, and brings in sixty-five abalone in a day; he begins to imagine a life with Kissy.

chapters.summary: 第二天潜水收获68只鲍鱼，喜悦子讲述六尊地藏守护神的传说与杀死死亡之王的预言，城堡守卫上岛打听邦德下落，喜悦子坚持当晚陪邦德游去城堡
chapters.title: THE SIX GUARDIANS
chapters.summary_en: A second day's diving yields sixty-eight abalone; Kissy tells of the six stone Jizo guardians and the prophecy of a man from overseas who will kill the King of Death, castle guards come to the island asking after Bond, and Kissy insists on swimming with him to the castle that night.

chapters.summary: 邦德与喜悦子夜游半英里海峡，邦德爬上200英尺城墙潜入毒花园，目睹食人鱼湖与跳入喷气孔自杀的男子，在园丁棚中过夜
chapters.title: THE LOVESOME SPOT
chapters.summary_en: Bond and Kissy swim half a mile across the strait; Bond climbs the two-hundred-foot wall into the poison garden, watches a suicide in the piranha lake and another in a fumarole, and spends the night in a gardener's hut.

chapters.summary: 白天邦德藏在园丁棚中，目睹守卫把反悔的自杀者扔进食人鱼湖，布洛菲尔德夫妇巡视时几乎发现他，布洛菲尔德用剑刺穿麻袋险些刺中邦德
chapters.title: SOMETHING EVIL COMES THIS WAY
chapters.summary_en: By day Bond hides in the hut, watches guards throw a would-be suicide who changed his mind into the piranha lake, and nearly dies when Blofeld, inspecting the garden with his wife, drives his sword through the sacks hiding him.

chapters.summary: 邦德夜间由低处小门潜入城堡，躲过捕人陷阱，却踩中走廊翻板陷阱坠入地牢，被守卫抓获，艾玛·布朗特认出他就是詹姆斯·邦德
chapters.title: OUBLIETTE
chapters.summary_en: Bond slips into the castle through a low door at night, dodges a man-trap, but steps on a trapdoor in the corridor and falls into the oubliette; captured, he is recognised by Irma Bunt as James Bond.

chapters.summary: 审讯室中布洛菲尔德用每15分钟喷发一次的千度泥浆间歇泉逼邦德开口，邦德在喷发前起身暴露自己听得懂，布洛菲尔德推断出邦德是为复仇而来并决定亲手杀他
chapters.title: THE QUESTION ROOM
chapters.summary_en: In the Question Room, built over a geyser that erupts every fifteen minutes with boiling mud, Blofeld tries to make Bond talk; Bond rises just before an eruption, betraying that he understands English, and Blofeld concludes he has come for revenge and will kill him himself.

chapters.summary: 邦德夺棍击昏艾玛·布朗特，与布洛菲尔德展开长棍对武士刀的搏斗，最终徒手扼死布洛菲尔德，关闭间歇泉阀门后城堡爆炸，邦德乘氢气球逃生、中弹坠海
chapters.title: BLOOD AND THUNDER
chapters.summary_en: Bond knocks Irma Bunt out with a stave, fights Blofeld - staff against samurai sword - and strangles him with his bare hands; shutting the geyser valve sets off the explosion that destroys the castle, and Bond escapes on a helium balloon, is shot and falls into the sea.

chapters.summary: M在报上发表邦德讣告，追述邦德身世、求学、参军与战功，宣布其日本任务百分之百成功，玛丽·古德奈特写下墓志铭
chapters.title: OBIT:
chapters.summary_en: M publishes Bond's obituary in the press, recounting his birth, schooling, war service and honours, declaring his Japanese mission one hundred per cent successful; Mary Goodnight writes the epitaph.

chapters.summary: 喜悦子从海中救起失忆的邦德，谎称他是渔民塔罗·托多罗基并藏匿于岛上，邦德与她同居、她怀孕，后因厕纸上符拉迪沃斯托克一词触动记忆，邦德决定前往苏联寻回过去
chapters.title: SPARROWS' TEARS
chapters.summary_en: Kissy rescues the amnesiac Bond from the sea and hides him on Kuro as the fisherman Taro Todoroki; they live together and she becomes pregnant, until the word Vladivostok on a scrap of toilet paper stirs his memory and he sails north to recover his past.

characters.age_clues: 讣告写11岁时父母双亡，1941年谎称19岁入职，1962年结婚

characters.habits: 抽烟、喝酒、赌博，爱吃生鸡蛋配培根，擅长潜水与搏斗
characters.personality: 丧妻后意志消沉、工作失误连连，但在绝境中求生意志与复仇决心极强，面对布洛菲尔德时冷静克制

characters.appearance_en: Tall, with a scar on his right cheek; in disguise his skin is dyed light brown, his black hair cut in a short Japanese fringe, and the ends of his eyebrows shaved so that they turn upwards.
characters.age_clues_en: The obituary says his parents died when he was eleven, that he joined up in 1941 claiming to be nineteen, and that he married in 1962.
characters.personality_en: After his wife's death he is sunk in apathy and bungles his work, but in desperate straits his will to live and his determination to take revenge are immense, and he faces Blofeld with cool restraint.
characters.habits_en: Smokes, drinks and gambles; likes raw eggs with bacon; an expert diver and fighter.
characters.background_en: His father Andrew Bond was a Scotsman of Glencoe and his mother Monique Delacroix a Swiss; both died in a climbing accident at Chamonix when he was eleven, and he was brought up by his aunt Charmian Bond. After a short time at Eton he moved to Fettes, joined the forerunner of the Ministry of Defence in 1941, stayed on in the Secret Service after the war, and was awarded the CMG.

characters.age_clues: 讣告写1962年结婚，婚后不到一天遇害；第13章写邦德回忆妻子死去刚九个月

characters.personality_en: Seen only through Bond's and Molony's memories: a wounded woman in need of help, which is why Bond fell in love with her.
characters.background_en: The only daughter of Marc-Ange Draco of Marseilles.

characters.appearance: 方脸、满口金牙、杏仁眼、体格魁梧，出生于虎年，穿黑浴衣，家中多虎头装饰
characters.background: 牛津大学三一学院PPE专业第一名，战前在伦敦日本大使馆任助理武官时为日本从事间谍活动，加入宪兵队，训练为神风特攻队员时战争结束，曾任大西英佐海军上将的私人副官，现任日本秘密情报机构Koan-Chosa-Kyoku首脑，柔道黑带七段
characters.habits: 喝三得利威士忌与清酒，爱开玩笑，讲究面子与恩义
characters.personality: 精明、深沉、幽默而残酷，极重荣誉与恩义，把国家利益置于个人交情之上

relationships.change: 由试探邦德的东道主变为以MAGIC44为筹码雇佣邦德行刺的指挥者，最后派人四处寻找失踪的邦德
多年好友，田中欠迪科一份大人情，此恩义是邦德得以会见田中的关键

characters.appearance_en: Square face, a mouthful of gold teeth, almond eyes and a powerful build; born in the Year of the Tiger, he wears a black yukata and his house is full of tiger-head ornaments.
characters.personality_en: Shrewd, deep, humorous and ruthless, fiercely bound by honour and obligation, putting his country's interests above personal friendship.
characters.habits_en: Drinks Suntory whisky and sake, loves a joke, and sets great store by face and obligation.
characters.background_en: First in PPE at Trinity College, Oxford; before the war he spied for Japan while assistant naval attache at the Japanese Embassy in London, joined the Kempeitai, and was training as a kamikaze pilot when the war ended; he was once private aide to Admiral Onishi, and is now head of the Koan-Chosa-Kyoku, the Japanese secret intelligence service, and a Seventh Dan black belt in judo.

characters.appearance: 身材巨大、灰白头发、破鼻梁、蓝眼睛、常出汗，穿皱巴巴的灰西装
characters.background: 澳大利亚外交官，驻东京情报负责人，邦德在日本的上线与掩护人
characters.habits: 酗酒、满口粗话、爱吃鳗鱼与嫖妓

characters.appearance_en: Enormously built, with grey-white hair, a broken nose, blue eyes, and a habit of sweating; he wears a crumpled grey suit.
characters.age_clues_en: Middle-aged, with the build of a retired boxer.
characters.personality_en: Coarse and outspoken, but loyal; he knows Japanese culture inside out and is the bridge between Bond and Tanaka.
characters.habits_en: Drinks heavily, swears constantly, and enjoys eels and brothels.
characters.background_en: An Australian diplomat, head of intelligence in Tokyo, and Bond's superior and cover in Japan.

characters.appearance: 身材比一般日本女孩高挑，皮肤金桃色，黑发带棕色挑染，眉毛不修，手脚粗糙多伤疤，潜水时裸体只系黑布三角
characters.background: 黑岛阿妈族渔家女儿，17岁被选中去好莱坞拍潜水女郎电影，厌恶好莱坞后回岛，父亲患风湿病不能摇船，母亲是老渔妇，家中有好莱坞片酬故比岛上其他人家宽裕
characters.habits: 潜水采鲍鱼、养鸬鹚大卫、讲英语
characters.personality: 直率、勇敢、独立、有主见，对邦德一见钟情并为留住他不惜说谎

喜悦子是神父教区的渔民之女，神父默许她藏匿邦德

characters.appearance_en: Taller than most Japanese girls, with golden-peach skin, black hair with brown highlights, unplucked eyebrows, and hands and feet roughened and scarred; when diving she wears nothing but a black cloth triangle.
characters.age_clues_en: Twenty-three years old; she went to Hollywood to make films at seventeen.
characters.personality_en: Direct, brave, independent and strong-willed; she falls in love with Bond at first sight and is ready to lie to keep him.
characters.habits_en: Dives for abalone, keeps the cormorant David, and speaks English.
characters.background_en: Daughter of an ama fishing family on Kuro Island; at seventeen she was chosen to go to Hollywood to make a film about ama divers, hated Hollywood and came home; her father cannot row the boat because of rheumatism, her mother is an old fisherwoman, and the family is better off than others on the island thanks to her Hollywood pay.

characters.age_clues: 原文写他长了垂下的黑胡子、修过梅毒鼻子、上排门牙有金牙套，留白发扮成伯爵
characters.appearance: 身高约6英尺3英寸、体格强壮，高额头、紫色薄唇、黑眼睛，扮萨特汉时穿中世纪锁子甲与带翼钢盔，平时穿绣金龙的黑丝绸和服
characters.background: 幽灵党创始人，曾策划霹雳弹核武器勒索与对英国的细菌战，杀害邦德妻子特蕾莎，化名瑞士植物学家萨特汉博士，携妻艾玛于当年1月进入日本，在九州建死亡花园
characters.habits: 穿盔甲巡视花园、听瓦格纳、与妻子用德语交谈
characters.name_zh: 恩斯特·斯塔夫罗·布洛菲尔德
characters.personality: 天才、自大、偏执，认为自己的罪行是公共服务与天才之举，晚年出现精神倦怠与妄想

relationships.change: 由邦德的追捕对象变为血仇对手，最终被邦德徒手扼死
夫妻与同谋，艾玛认出邦德并协助审问，布洛菲尔德死后她亦死于城堡毁灭
布洛菲尔德雇佣黑龙会余党为守卫并派特工跟踪田中，视田中为主要敌人

characters.appearance_en: About six feet three, powerfully built, with a high forehead, thin purple lips and black eyes; as Shatterhand he wears medieval chain mail and a winged steel helmet, and at other times a black silk kimono embroidered with a gold dragon.
characters.age_clues_en: The novel describes his drooping black beard, a nose repaired after syphilis, gold caps on his upper front teeth, and the white hair he wears in his disguise as a count.
characters.personality_en: A genius, arrogant and paranoid, convinced that his crimes are public service and the work of genius; in his later years he suffers from lassitude of mind and delusions.
characters.habits_en: Inspects the garden in armour, listens to Wagner, and speaks German with his wife.
characters.background_en: Founder of SPECTRE; he once planned the Thunderball nuclear blackmail and a germ-warfare attack on Britain, and murdered Bond's wife Teresa; under the name of the Swiss botanist Dr Shatterhand he entered Japan with his wife Irma in January of that year and built the garden of death in Kyushu.

characters.appearance: 身材矮壮、相貌丑陋、扁平面孔、淡褐近黄的眼睛、头发向后梳成发髻，出门穿养蜂人式的深绿草帽加黑面纱
characters.background: 原名艾玛·布朗特，布洛菲尔德的同谋与妻子，化名萨特汉夫人随丈夫进入日本
characters.habits: 做针线活、协助布洛菲尔德审问俘虏
characters.personality: 冷酷、顺从丈夫、对邦德怀有刻骨仇恨，是认出化装后邦德的人

relationships.change: 夫妻与同谋，共同经营死亡城堡
她一眼认出化装后的邦德，促成审问与处决

characters.appearance_en: Short and stocky, ugly, with a flat face, light-brown eyes verging on yellow, and hair combed back into a bun; outdoors she wears a beekeeper-like dark-green straw hat with a black veil.
characters.personality_en: Cold, obedient to her husband, and consumed with hatred of Bond; she is the one who recognises the disguised Bond.
characters.habits_en: Does needlework and helps Blofeld interrogate prisoners.
characters.background_en: Born Irma Bunt, Blofeld's accomplice and wife, who entered Japan with him under the name of Frau Shatterhand.

characters.appearance: 原文未详写外貌，写他是海军出身、面容多皱纹
characters.background: 邦德的上司，秘密情报部门首脑
characters.habits: 抽烟斗、爱去布莱兹俱乐部
characters.personality: 严厉、务实，对邦德既失望又信任，最终为邦德写讣告

relationships.change: 由考虑让邦德退役改为派他去日本执行不可能的任务，最后认定其任务百分之百成功

characters.appearance_en: The novel does not describe his appearance in detail, noting only that he is a former naval man with a much-lined face.
characters.personality_en: Severe and practical; disappointed in Bond yet trusting him, and in the end he writes Bond's obituary.
characters.habits_en: Smokes a pipe and enjoys Blades club.
characters.background_en: Bond's chief, head of the Secret Service.

characters.background: M的秘书
characters.personality: 对邦德抱有好感，邦德领命后吻了她的脸颊

relationships.change: 邦德恢复精神后吻她脸颊并托她转告晚餐邀请

characters.personality_en: Fond of Bond; after he takes the assignment he kisses her on the cheek.
characters.background_en: M's secretary.

characters.background: 邦德的秘书，在讣告后署名M.G.写墓志铭
characters.personality: 关心邦德，常为他操心

relationships.change: 邦德失踪后她为讣告写下墓志铭

characters.personality_en: Caring about Bond and often worrying over him.
characters.background_en: Bond's secretary, who signs herself M.G. in the epitaph she writes after the obituary.

characters.background: M的参谋长，邦德在部门中最好的朋友
characters.personality: 坦率、支持邦德

relationships.change: 为邦德做任务简报并安排掩护身份

characters.personality_en: Frank and supportive of Bond.
characters.background_en: M's Chief of Staff and Bond's best friend in the Service.

characters.background: 英格兰最伟大的神经学家，获诺贝尔奖，秘密情报部门的特聘神经专科医生
characters.personality: 富有同情心，坚持认为邦德只是受了精神打击，建议给邦德一个看似不可能的重要任务来治愈他

relationships.change: 两次检查邦德后向M进言，促成日本任务

characters.personality_en: Sympathetic; convinced Bond is only suffering from shock, he urges giving him one apparently impossible, important assignment to cure him.
characters.background_en: England's greatest neurologist, a Nobel laureate, and nerve specialist by appointment to the Secret Service.

characters.appearance: 年轻艺妓，皮肤柔软，棕色眼睛
characters.background: 田中虎请客的艺妓晚宴上的艺妓，答应邦德赢了剪刀石头布就给真吻
characters.personality: 娇羞、活泼

relationships.change: 晚宴上与邦德调情，邦德赢了游戏后她吻了邦德

characters.appearance_en: A young geisha with soft skin and brown eyes.
characters.personality_en: Shy and lively.
characters.background_en: A geisha at the dinner given by Tiger Tanaka, who promises Bond a real kiss if he wins at scissors-paper-stone.

characters.appearance: 涂黑牙齿、浓妆如能剧人物
characters.background: 艺妓晚宴的老鸨
characters.personality: 风趣，拿邦德的名字开玩笑

relationships.change: 为邦德与田中的晚宴翻译并助兴

characters.appearance_en: Blackened teeth and heavy make-up like a figure from a Noh play.
characters.personality_en: Witty; she makes a joke of Bond's name.
characters.background_en: The Madame of the geisha dinner.

characters.appearance: 年轻漂亮，只穿紧身短裤与白色胸衣
characters.background: 澡堂女招待，名字意为真理第一号
characters.personality: 温顺、妩媚

relationships.change: 为邦德做染肤、洗浴、理发与按摩，帮他完成化装的第一步

characters.appearance_en: Young and pretty, wearing only tight shorts and a white bodice.
characters.personality_en: Docile and seductive.
characters.background_en: A bath-house attendant whose name means Truth Number One.

characters.appearance: 身材矮小、穿便服的壮汉
characters.background: 死亡城堡的守卫头目，曾为德国人或宪兵队工作，懂德语，为布洛菲尔德做翻译
characters.personality: 对布洛菲尔德毕恭毕敬，对邦德怀有戒心

relationships.change: 抓获邦德并主持审问，最后按布洛菲尔德命令准备刑具

characters.appearance_en: A short, powerfully built man in civilian clothes.
characters.personality_en: Deferential to Blofeld and suspicious of Bond.
characters.background_en: Chief of the castle guards; he once worked for the Germans or the Kempeitai, speaks German, and acts as Blofeld's interpreter.

characters.background: 死亡城堡守卫，负责拷打俘虏
characters.personality: 残忍，被邦德一脚踢中裆部后倒地不起

relationships.change: 拷打邦德时被邦德反击致伤

characters.appearance_en: A bald, powerfully built man with hands like hams.
characters.personality_en: Cruel; Bond's kick to the groin leaves him floored.
characters.background_en: A castle guard who tortures prisoners.

characters.appearance: 圆脸、戴圆眼镜、穿深红礼服与绿松石裙
characters.background: 黑岛神道神父，岛上精神领袖
characters.personality: 睿智、威严，知晓邦德使命并给予祝福，最后默许喜悦子藏匿邦德

relationships.change: 接纳邦德上岛并为其使命祝福，最后协助隐瞒邦德行踪
神父指示长老们对搜查者装作一无所知

characters.appearance_en: Round face, round spectacles, and a dark-red ceremonial robe with a turquoise skirt.
characters.personality_en: Wise and commanding; he knows Bond's mission and blesses it, and at the end he lets Kissy hide Bond.
characters.background_en: The Shinto priest of Kuro Island and its spiritual leader.

characters.appearance: 戴无框眼镜、目光锐利、军人气质
characters.background: 九州南部刑事调查部门负责人，曾任宪兵队总部所在地福冈的警官，与黑岛铃木家有远亲关系
characters.personality: 干练、恭敬

relationships.change: 向邦德展示死亡城堡航拍图并安排其住进黑岛铃木家

characters.appearance_en: Rimless spectacles, sharp eyes and a military bearing.
characters.personality_en: Efficient and respectful.
characters.background_en: Head of criminal investigation in southern Kyushu; once a police officer in Fukuoka, the former Kempeitai headquarters, and a distant relative of the Suzuki family of Kuro.

characters.age_clues: 年迈、关节肿胀、患风湿病
characters.appearance: 瘦弱灰白胡子的老人，眼睛如松鼠般明亮
characters.background: 黑岛渔民，喜悦子的父亲，原为女儿摇船，后因风湿病不能出海
characters.personality: 和蔼、随和

relationships.change: 接纳邦德住进家中，邦德替他为女儿摇船

characters.appearance_en: A thin old man with a grey-white beard and bright, squirrel-like eyes.
characters.age_clues_en: Old, with swollen joints and rheumatism.
characters.personality_en: Kind and easy-going.
characters.background_en: A fisherman of Kuro Island and Kissy's father; he once rowed the boat for his daughter but can no longer go to sea because of rheumatism.

characters.background: 黑岛渔妇，喜悦子的母亲
characters.personality: 精明、慈爱

relationships.change: 接纳邦德住进家中

characters.appearance_en: An old fisherwoman with a walnut face.
characters.personality_en: Shrewd and loving.
characters.background_en: A fisherwoman of Kuro Island and Kissy's mother.

characters.background: 黑岛医生，为邦德治伤，诊断其颞叶受损导致失忆
characters.personality: 谨慎、遵从神父指示

relationships.change: 为失忆的邦德治伤并指导喜悦子护理

characters.personality_en: Cautious, and obedient to the priest's instructions.
characters.background_en: The doctor of Kuro Island, who treats Bond's wounds and diagnoses the temporal-lobe injury behind his amnesia.

characters.appearance: 黑色大鸬鹚，绿松石色眼睛，翼展约5英尺，颈上套铜环
characters.background: 喜悦子养的捕鱼鸬鹚，以演员大卫·尼文命名
characters.personality: 高傲、忠诚

relationships.change: 陪邦德与喜悦子出海捕鱼

characters.appearance_en: A large black cormorant with turquoise eyes, a wingspan of about five feet and a copper ring round its neck.
characters.age_clues_en: Three years old; Kissy rescued it as a chick.
characters.personality_en: Proud and loyal.
characters.habits_en: Catches fish and dives with Kissy.
characters.background_en: Kissy's fishing cormorant, named after the actor David Niven.

characters.background: 布莱兹俱乐部侍者，曾在M手下服役
characters.personality: 细心、体贴

relationships.change: 在布莱兹俱乐部侍候M与莫洛尼

characters.personality_en: Attentive and considerate.
characters.background_en: A waiter at Blades club who once served under M.

communications.name: 红色电话
communications.note: M办公室的内部电话，邦德接M召唤用此线
communications.description_en: The internal telephone in M's office, by which Bond is summoned.

communications.name: 同步发报机
communications.note: 邦德按规定外出时应随身携带的呼叫器，他多周未带
communications.description_en: The bleeper senior Headquarters staff are required to carry when they leave the building; Bond has not carried his for weeks.

communications.name: 电报与密码电文
communications.note: 迪科经墨尔本向伦敦传递邦德的情报；MAGIC44密电要求收报后销毁并以土星为确认代号
communications.description_en: Dikko sends Bond's intelligence to London by way of Melbourne; the MAGIC 44 decrypt must be destroyed after receipt, with Saturn as the confirmation codeword.

communications.name: 电话
communications.note: 安藤警视用老式电话向手下查询黑龙会特工的底细
communications.description_en: Superintendent Ando uses an old-fashioned telephone to ask his men about the Black Dragon agent.

equipment.note: 邦德按日本法律携带的刀片不超过两英寸的折刀，用于锉断城堡小门的锁链
equipment.description_en: The folding knife Bond carries within the Japanese legal limit of a two-inch blade, used to file through the chain on the castle's small door.

equipment.note: 邦德腰间缠绕的细钢链，原计划用于勒死布洛菲尔德
equipment.description_en: The fine steel chain wound round Bond's waist, originally intended for strangling Blofeld.

equipment.note: 黑棉忍者服配头罩与游泳镜，潜水与夜间潜入时穿着，另有日间迷彩服
equipment.description_en: A black cotton ninja suit with hood and swimming goggles, worn for diving and the night approach, with a daytime camouflage suit besides.

equipment.note: 邦德在城堡图书馆夺取守卫留下的约两码长棍，用以对付布洛菲尔德的武士刀
equipment.description_en: A stave about two yards long, seized from a guard left in the castle library, which Bond uses against Blofeld's samurai sword.

equipment.note: 布洛菲尔德的宽刃武士刀，他企图用此刀按切舍御免斩首邦德，最后被邦德夺下劈开阀门木箱
equipment.description_en: Blofeld's broad-bladed samurai sword, with which he means to behead Bond by kirisute gomen; Bond seizes it and uses it to split open the wooden box over the valve.

equipment.note: 邦德攀爬200英尺城墙时使用，绳端带铁钩
equipment.description_en: The pitons and rope, with a grappling hook at the end, that Bond uses to climb the two-hundred-foot castle wall.

equipment.note: 邦德游过半英里海峡时使用，潜水镜属于喜悦子的父亲
equipment.description_en: The flippers and goggles Bond uses to swim the half-mile strait; the goggles belong to Kissy's father.

equipment.note: 田中虎赠给邦德的棕色长药丸，以防任务失败被俘，邦德拒绝接受并归还
equipment.description_en: The long brown pill Tiger Tanaka gives Bond in case the mission fails and he is captured; Bond refuses it and hands it back.

equipment.note: 邦德潜入装备中的提神药片
equipment.description_en: The Benzedrine tablets in Bond's infiltration kit, to keep him awake.

equipment.note: 邦德藏身园丁棚期间的食物，共三块
equipment.description_en: Bond's food while hiding in the gardener's hut - three pieces of pemmican.

equipment.note: 日本本地香烟，邦德在日本期间抽用
equipment.description_en: A Japanese brand of cigarette, which Bond smokes while in Japan.

events.cause: 邦德丧妻后精神崩溃，莫洛尼向M建议给邦德一个看似不可能的重要任务
events.effect: 邦德获代理晋升外交部门，以澳大利亚外交官身份前往日本索取MAGIC44
events.title: M委派不可能的任务
events.title_en: M Gives Bond the Impossible Mission
events.cause_en: Bond is falling apart after his wife's death, and Molony advises M to give him one apparently impossible, vital assignment.
events.effect_en: Bond receives an acting promotion to the Diplomatic Section and travels to Japan as an Australian diplomat to obtain MAGIC 44.

events.cause: 田中向邦德展示MAGIC44破译的苏联密电，内容是200兆吨核武器试验与讹诈英国的计划
events.effect: 邦德凭记忆把密电内容经迪科传回伦敦，西方迅速采取反制，苏联推迟外交讹诈
events.title: 田中出示MAGIC44样本密电
events.title_en: Tanaka Shows the Sample MAGIC 44 Decrypt
events.cause_en: Tanaka shows Bond a MAGIC 44 decrypt of a Soviet message about a 200-megaton weapon test and a plan to blackmail Britain.
events.effect_en: Bond memorises the decrypt and sends it to London through Dikko; the West acts swiftly and the Soviet diplomatic blackmail is postponed.

events.cause: 日本已渗透英国澳门蓝色通道情报网，邦德无物可换，田中提出以刺杀换MAGIC44
events.effect: 邦德接受交易，潜入死亡城堡杀死萨特汉博士，换取日本移交MAGIC44
events.title: 以刺杀换MAGIC44的交易
events.cause_en: Japan has already penetrated Britain's Macao Blue Route network, leaving Bond with nothing to trade, and Tanaka offers murder in exchange for MAGIC 44.
events.effect_en: Bond accepts the bargain and agrees to enter the Castle of Death and kill Dr Shatterhand in return for Japan handing over MAGIC 44.

events.cause: 邦德是外国人，在日本极易被认出，必须化装成日本人潜入
events.effect: 邦德染肤、剪发、扮成福冈聋哑煤矿工人，化名塔罗·托多罗基
events.title: 邦德化装成日本渔民工人
events.title_en: Bond Is Made Up as a Japanese Labourer
events.cause_en: As a foreigner, Bond would be recognised at once in Japan and must pass as Japanese to get near the castle.
events.effect_en: Bond's skin is dyed and his hair cut, and he becomes Taro Todoroki, a deaf-mute coalminer from Fukuoka.

events.cause: 黑龙会特工一路跟踪田中与邦德，邦德识破后设伏拦截
events.effect: 特工被警察刺死，身上搜出邦德被窃的钱包与记录田中行踪的日记，邦德意识到城堡主人早有防备
events.title: 跟踪的黑龙会特工被杀
events.title_en: The Black Dragon Tail Is Killed
events.cause_en: A Black Dragon agent tails Tanaka and Bond all the way, and Bond sees through the tail and sets a trap.
events.effect_en: The agent is stabbed to death by a policeman; his body yields Bond's stolen wallet and a diary of Tanaka's movements, and Bond realises the castle's master is already on his guard.

events.cause: 邦德在安藤警视处看到萨特汉博士夫妇的护照照片
events.effect: 邦德认出两人就是布洛菲尔德与艾玛·布朗特，决定隐瞒身份、私自复仇
events.title: 邦德认出布洛菲尔德
events.cause_en: Bond sees the passport photographs of Dr and Frau Shatterhand at Superintendent Ando's office.
events.effect_en: He recognises the couple as Blofeld and Irma Bunt and decides to keep the discovery secret and take his revenge himself.

events.cause: 邦德需在城堡对面等待合适天气与夜色潜入
events.effect: 邦德住进黑岛铃木家，结识喜悦子并与她出海潜水
events.title: 邦德抵达黑岛
events.cause_en: Bond must wait on the far side of the strait for the right weather and a moonlit night to swim to the castle.
events.effect_en: He lodges with the Suzuki family on Kuro, meets Kissy and goes diving for abalone with her.

events.cause: 喜悦子坚持陪邦德夜游，并约定每晚午夜在城墙下等他一小时
events.effect: 邦德得以在喜悦子引导下穿越海流抵达城墙，事后喜悦子在海中救起他
events.title: 夜游至死亡城堡
events.title_en: The Night Swim to the Castle of Death
events.cause_en: Kissy insists on swimming with Bond to the castle and promises to wait for an hour at midnight below the wall each night.
events.effect_en: Guided by Kissy through the currents, Bond reaches the wall; afterwards Kissy pulls him from the sea.

events.cause: 邦德爬上城墙潜入毒花园侦察
events.effect: 邦德目睹食人鱼湖与喷气孔自杀，在园丁棚藏身并找到城堡低处小门
events.title: 潜入毒花园
events.cause_en: Bond climbs the castle wall to reconnoitre the poison garden.
events.effect_en: He watches the piranha lake and a suicide in a fumarole, hides in a gardener's hut and finds the low door into the castle.

events.cause: 布洛菲尔德夫妇巡视花园，布洛菲尔德发现园丁棚门开着
events.effect: 布洛菲尔德用剑刺穿麻袋，险些刺中藏身的邦德，邦德决定当夜行动
events.title: 布洛菲尔德险些发现邦德
events.cause_en: Blofeld and his wife inspect the garden, and Blofeld notices the door of the gardener's hut standing open.
events.effect_en: Blofeld drives his sword through the sacks, narrowly missing the hidden Bond, who resolves to act that night.

events.cause: 邦德由小门潜入城堡，踩中走廊翻板陷阱
events.effect: 邦德坠入地牢被俘，艾玛·布朗特认出他的身份
events.title: 坠入地牢被俘
events.cause_en: Bond enters the castle by the low door and steps on a trapdoor in the corridor.
events.effect_en: He falls into the oubliette and is captured; Irma Bunt recognises him as James Bond.

events.cause: 布洛菲尔德要验证邦德是否真的聋哑
events.effect: 邦德在间歇泉喷发前起身，暴露自己听得懂英语，布洛菲尔德推断他是为复仇而来
events.title: 审讯室间歇泉逼供
events.cause_en: Blofeld wants to test whether Bond is truly deaf and dumb.
events.effect_en: Bond rises just before the geyser erupts, betraying that he understands English, and Blofeld concludes he has come for revenge.

events.cause: 布洛菲尔德决定亲手用武士刀斩首邦德
events.effect: 邦德夺棍击昏艾玛·布朗特，徒手扼死布洛菲尔德，随后关闭间歇泉阀门引发城堡爆炸
events.title: 死亡城堡决战
events.title_en: The Duel in the Castle of Death
events.cause_en: Blofeld decides to behead Bond himself with his samurai sword.
events.effect_en: Bond knocks Irma Bunt out with his stave and strangles Blofeld with his bare hands, then shuts the geyser valve and the castle explodes.

events.cause: 邦德乘氢气球逃生时中弹坠海，伦敦方面失去他的消息
events.effect: M发表讣告，宣布邦德失踪、推定死亡，任务百分之百成功
events.title: M发表邦德讣告
events.cause_en: Bond escapes on the helium balloon, is shot and falls into the sea, and London hears nothing more of him.
events.effect_en: M publishes the obituary, announcing Bond missing and presumed dead and the mission one hundred per cent successful.

events.cause: 喜悦子在城墙下等候时看到邦德坠海，游去救起失忆的他
events.effect: 邦德以塔罗·托多罗基的身份在黑岛生活数月，喜悦子怀孕，后因符拉迪沃斯托克一词决定离岛寻回记忆
events.title: 喜悦子救起失忆的邦德
events.cause_en: Kissy, waiting below the wall, sees Bond fall into the sea and swims out to save him.
events.effect_en: Bond lives on Kuro as Taro Todoroki for months, Kissy becomes pregnant, and at last the word Vladivostok sends him off the island to recover his memory.

facts.fact: 邦德丧妻八个月后精神崩溃，酗酒、赌博、工作失误，被莫洛尼诊断为精神打击导致的神经症
facts.quote: He's going slowly to pieces.
facts.fact_en: Eight months after his wife's death, Bond is falling apart - drinking, gambling and making mistakes at work - and Molony diagnoses a psycho-neurosis brought on by shock.

facts.fact: 邦德的妻子特蕾莎在婚后数小时内被布洛菲尔德枪杀，邦德自责是自己害死了她
facts.quote: within a few hours she's shot dead by this super-gangster chap.
facts.fact_en: Bond's wife Teresa was shot dead by Blofeld within hours of their wedding, and Bond blames himself for her death.

facts.fact: 神经学家詹姆斯·莫洛尼爵士两次检查邦德，认为他身体无恙只是受了打击，建议M给他一个看似不可能的重要任务
facts.quote: Give him one more chance, M.
facts.fact_en: The neurologist Sir James Molony examined Bond twice, found nothing physically wrong, and advised M to give him one apparently impossible, important assignment.

facts.fact: M给邦德代理晋升外交部门并加薪每年1000英镑，派他去日本索取MAGIC44
facts.quote: I'm giving you acting promotion to the Diplomatic Section.
facts.fact_en: M gives Bond an acting promotion to the Diplomatic Section, with a thousand pounds a year extra pay, and sends him to Japan to obtain MAGIC 44.

facts.fact: 日本秘密情报机构首脑田中虎掌控着破译苏联符拉迪沃斯托克方向密电的成果MAGIC44，美国中央情报局不许他转交给英国
facts.quote: You're to go out there and get it off him.
facts.fact_en: Tiger Tanaka, head of the Japanese secret service, controls MAGIC 44, the decryption of Soviet traffic from Vladivostok, which the CIA forbids him to pass to Britain.

facts.fact: 理查德·洛夫莱斯·亨德森是澳大利亚驻东京情报负责人，邦德以澳大利亚大使馆文化处二等秘书身份作掩护
facts.quote: Second Secretary in the Cultural Department of the Australian Embassy.
facts.fact_en: Richard Lovelace Henderson is the Australian intelligence chief in Tokyo, and Bond works under cover as Second Secretary in the Cultural Department of the Australian Embassy.

facts.fact: 田中在银座梅洛迪酒吧桌下装窃听器监听迪科与邦德，迪科发现后扯掉电线
facts.quote: we've been miked! That bludger Tanaka's miked us!
facts.fact_en: Tanaka has the Melody Bar table in the Ginza bugged to listen to Dikko and Bond; Dikko finds the microphone and tears out the wire.

facts.fact: 田中的办公室设在东京一座废弃地铁站内，上方以全亚细亚民俗局为掩护，入口有夜莺地板与录音机伪装的施工声
facts.quote: It is quiet. It is private. It is also cool.
facts.fact_en: Tanaka's office sits in a disused underground station in Tokyo, fronted by the Bureau of All-Asian Folkways, its entrance guarded by a nightingale floor and the recorded sound of building work.

facts.fact: MAGIC44样本密电称苏联拥有200兆吨武器，定于9月20日在新地岛高空试爆，并将以此讹诈英国拆除美国基地、实现核裁军
facts.quote: WE ARE IN POSSESSION OF THE TWO HUNDRED MEGATON WEAPON
facts.fact_en: The sample MAGIC 44 decrypt says the Soviet Union possesses a 200-megaton weapon, to be tested high over Novaya Zemlya on 20 September, and will use it to blackmail Britain into removing American bases and accepting nuclear disarmament.

facts.fact: 邦德凭记忆记下密电全文，田中暗示他应把内容传回伦敦，邦德经迪科的墨尔本渠道发出情报
facts.quote: You remember its contents? Exactly, I think.
facts.fact_en: Bond memorises the whole decrypt, Tanaka hints that he should send its contents to London, and Bond transmits the intelligence through Dikko's Melbourne channel.

facts.fact: 200兆吨核试验如期举行并引发公众抗议，西方迅速反制，苏联的外交讹诈被无限期推迟
facts.quote: The test of the zoo-megaton bomb had duly taken place
facts.fact_en: The 200-megaton test duly takes place and draws public protest; the swift Western response postpones the Soviet diplomatic blackmail indefinitely.

facts.fact: 日本早已渗透英国的澳门蓝色通道情报网并改称橙色通道，邦德用作交换的筹码因此作废
facts.quote: We already receive the entire fruits of that source.
facts.fact_en: Japan has long since penetrated Britain's Macao Blue Route intelligence network and renamed it the Orange Route, so Bond's intended bargaining chip is worthless.

facts.fact: 萨特汉博士夫妇持瑞士护照于当年1月合法入境日本，自称热带植物学家，获准花100万英镑在九州建珍奇植物园并取得十年居留许可
facts.quote: He collects death.
facts.fact_en: Dr Shatterhand and his wife entered Japan legally in January on Swiss passports, claiming to be tropical botanists, and were allowed to spend a million pounds building a garden of rare plants in Kyushu with a ten-year residence permit.

facts.fact: 萨特汉在福冈附近的半岛上买下500英亩火山地带的古城堡，雇佣约20名前黑龙会成员为守卫，园中遍植毒植物、放养食人鱼与毒蛇毒蛛
facts.quote: He collects death.
facts.fact_en: Shatterhand bought an old castle on five hundred acres of volcanic land near Fukuoka, hired about twenty former Black Dragon men as guards, and filled the garden with poison plants, piranhas, and venomous snakes and spiders.

facts.fact: 死亡花园在不到六个月内已吸引500多名日本人前来此自杀
facts.quote: His present tally, in just under six months, is something over five hundred Japanese.
facts.fact_en: In under six months the garden of death has drawn more than five hundred Japanese to kill themselves there.

facts.fact: 日本每年有25000人自杀，自杀在日本文化中不被视为耻辱，反而被看作荣誉之举
facts.quote: 25,000 Japanese commit suicide every year.
facts.fact_en: Some 25,000 Japanese kill themselves every year, and in Japanese culture suicide is not seen as shameful but as an honourable act.

facts.fact: 田中派去死亡城堡调查的特工一周后在海滩被发现，双目失明、下半身严重烧伤，临死只念写蜻蜓的俳句
facts.quote: Desolation! Pink dragonflies flitting above the graves.
facts.fact_en: Tanaka's agent sent to the Castle of Death was found a week later on a beach, blinded and badly burned below the waist, dying with only a haiku about dragonflies on his lips.

facts.fact: 田中与首相商定：邦德潜入死亡城堡杀死城堡主人，成功则日本移交MAGIC44，失败则拒绝英国的请求
facts.quote: You are to enter this Castle of Death and slay the Dragon within.
facts.fact_en: Tanaka, in agreement with the Prime Minister, offers the bargain: Bond will enter the Castle of Death and kill its master, and Japan will hand over MAGIC 44 if he succeeds - and refuse Britain's request if he fails.

facts.fact: 邦德在澡堂接受染肤、剪发等化装，扮成日本人，化名福冈聋哑煤矿工人塔罗·托多罗基
facts.quote: A coalminer from Fukuoka.
facts.fact_en: In a bath-house Bond is dyed, shaved and made up to pass as Japanese, under the name of Taro Todoroki, a deaf-mute coalminer from Fukuoka.

facts.fact: 田中曾在柏林与罗马做情报工作，后辞去宪兵队职务、贿赂进入神风特攻队训练中队，投降前未及出击
facts.quote: I forced the Kempeitai to accept my resignation
facts.fact_en: Tanaka worked in intelligence in Berlin and Rome, resigned from the Kempeitai by bribery, and joined a kamikaze training squadron, but the surrender came before he could fly a mission.

facts.fact: 田中带邦德参观忍者训练学校中央登山学校，演示徒手攀墙、长棍术与忍者器械，一名学员失足坠入护城河淹死
facts.quote: ninjutsu, which is, literally, the art of stealth or invisibility.
facts.fact_en: Tanaka takes Bond to a ninjutsu training school, the Central Mountaineering School, to watch wall-climbing, staff fighting and ninja devices; one pupil slips and drowns in the moat.

facts.fact: 田中是柔道黑带七段，未晋升红带，认为高段柔道家如同僧侣与芭蕾舞者
facts.quote: No higher than a Black Belt of the Seventh Dan.
facts.fact_en: Tanaka holds a Seventh Dan black belt in judo, has not risen to red belt, and regards high-ranking judoka as akin to monks and ballet dancers.

facts.fact: 邦德在濑户内海船上即兴写下俳句你只活两次，成为全书题名的来源
facts.quote: You only live twice: Once when you are born And once when you look death in the face.
facts.fact_en: On a boat in the Inland Sea Bond improvises the haiku You only live twice, which gives the novel its title.

facts.fact: 邦德在别府参观十大地狱并吃河豚宴，河豚肝脏与性腺含剧毒，餐馆须由专家经营并向国家注册
facts.quote: Fugu is the Japanese blow-fish.
facts.fact_en: In Beppu Bond tours the Ten Hells and eats a fugu dinner; the blowfish's liver and sexual organs are deadly poison, and the restaurant must be run by an expert and registered with the state.

facts.fact: 跟踪田中与邦德的黑龙会特工在福冈途中被警察刺死，身上有邦德被窃的钱包与记录田中行踪的日记，其手臂有黑龙纹身
facts.quote: He is a Black Dragon.
facts.fact_en: The Black Dragon agent tailing Tanaka and Bond is stabbed to death by a policeman on the way to Fukuoka; on him are Bond's stolen wallet and a diary recording Tanaka's movements, and his arm bears a black dragon tattoo.

facts.fact: 邦德看到萨特汉博士夫妇护照照片后认出他们就是布洛菲尔德与艾玛·布朗特，决定隐瞒身份以便私自复仇
facts.quote: Ernst Stavro Blofeld. Irma Bunt.
facts.fact_en: Seeing the passport photographs of Dr and Frau Shatterhand, Bond recognises them as Ernst Stavro Blofeld and Irma Bunt, and decides to hide the discovery so he can take his revenge himself.

facts.fact: 喜悦子23岁，17岁时去好莱坞拍潜水女郎电影，厌恶好莱坞后回黑岛，被称为日本的嘉宝
facts.quote: They christened her The Japanese Garbo.
facts.fact_en: Kissy Suzuki is twenty-three; at seventeen she went to Hollywood to make a film about ama divers, hated Hollywood and came home to Kuro, where she is called the Japanese Garbo.

facts.fact: 邦德住进黑岛铃木家，化名塔罗·托多罗基，神父知晓其使命并祝福，邦德替患风湿病的父亲为喜悦子摇船
facts.quote: My name is Taro Todoroki
facts.fact_en: Bond lodges with the Suzuki family on Kuro Island as Taro Todoroki; the Shinto priest knows his mission and blesses it, and Bond rows the boat for Kissy in place of her rheumatic father.

facts.fact: 田中赠给邦德一粒自杀药丸以防被俘，邦德拒绝接受并归还
facts.quote: You only live twice.
facts.fact_en: Tanaka gives Bond a suicide pill to take if he is captured; Bond refuses it and hands it back.

facts.fact: 喜悦子养了一只名叫大卫的鸬鹚，以演员大卫·尼文命名，颈上套铜环，能衔大鱼出水
facts.quote: I named him after the only man I liked in Hollywood
facts.fact_en: Kissy keeps a cormorant called David, named after the actor David Niven, with a copper ring round its neck; it can bring up large fish in its beak.

facts.fact: 邦德与喜悦子出海一天采得65只鲍鱼，其中邦德采得10只，喜悦子一次潜水可闭气近一分钟
facts.quote: That is twenty-one. Very good.
facts.fact_en: Bond and Kissy gather sixty-five abalone in a day's diving, ten of them Bond's, and Kissy can hold her breath for nearly a minute at a time.

facts.fact: 黑岛岸边有六尊地藏守护神石像，第六尊的头已被海浪冲毁，岛民相信它们会派来一个海外男子杀死死亡之王
facts.quote: They are rather frightening to see.
facts.fact_en: Six stone Jizo guardian statues stand on the shore of Kuro; the sixth has lost its head to the sea, and the islanders believe they will send a man from overseas to kill the King of Death.

facts.fact: 城堡守卫上岛打听警察快艇第三名乘客的下落，岛民装作一无所知，神父谎称那人是渔业执照官员
facts.quote: shiran-kao, which is the face of him who knows nothing
facts.fact_en: Castle guards come to the island asking after the third passenger on the police launch; the islanders pretend to know nothing, and the priest claims the man was a fisheries licensing official.

facts.fact: 邦德与喜悦子夜游半英里海峡，爬上200英尺城墙潜入毒花园，耗时20分钟，只用两次岩钉
facts.quote: It took him twenty minutes to cover the two hundred feet
facts.fact_en: Bond and Kissy swim half a mile across the strait at night, and Bond climbs the two-hundred-foot castle wall in twenty minutes, using only two pitons.

facts.fact: 邦德目睹一名自杀者被毒植物灼伤面部后跳入食人鱼湖被鱼群撕咬致死，另一名穿礼服的男子平静走入喷气孔自尽
facts.quote: Piranha! The South American fresh-water killer
facts.fact_en: Bond watches one suicide, his face burned by poison plants, throw himself into the piranha lake and be torn apart by the fish, and another man in evening dress walk calmly into a fumarole to die.

facts.fact: 守卫把一名反悔的自杀者扔进食人鱼湖取乐，布洛菲尔德夫妇巡视时布洛菲尔德用剑刺穿邦德藏身的麻袋堆，险些刺中邦德
facts.quote: There is nothing, but remind me to reprimand Kono
facts.fact_en: Guards throw a suicide who has changed his mind into the piranha lake for sport, and while Blofeld and his wife inspect the garden, Blofeld drives his sword through the pile of sacks where Bond is hiding, narrowly missing him.

facts.fact: 布洛菲尔德与艾玛用德语交谈，透露他计划事发后索取巨额赔偿并转移到巴西等地重建死亡景点，认为死亡花园是其天才的独创
facts.quote: It is the concept that matters, liebe Irma.
facts.fact_en: Blofeld and Irma speak German together, revealing his plan to demand huge compensation if the affair comes out and to rebuild his garden of death in Brazil or elsewhere, convinced that the garden is his stroke of genius.

facts.fact: 邦德由城堡低处小门潜入，躲过捕人陷阱，却踩中走廊翻板陷阱坠入地牢，被守卫抓获并剥去忍者服
facts.quote: the traditional oubliette of ancient castles!
facts.fact_en: Bond enters the castle through a low door, dodges a man-trap, but steps on a trapdoor in the corridor and falls into the oubliette, where the guards seize him and strip off his ninja suit.

facts.fact: 艾玛·布朗特凭右颊疤痕认出化装后的邦德，指出他就是杀妻仇人詹姆斯·邦德、曾化名希拉里·布雷爵士
facts.quote: This is the English agent. This is the man Bond, James Bond
facts.fact_en: Irma Bunt recognises the disguised Bond by the scar on his right cheek, naming him as James Bond, the man who once passed as Sir Hilary Bray.

facts.fact: 审讯室设在间歇泉上方，邦德坐在石座上，泉水每15分钟喷发一次，千度泥浆可把人下半身烧毁
facts.quote: You have exactly eleven minutes before the next eruption.
facts.fact_en: The Question Room is built over a geyser; Bond sits on a stone seat while the geyser erupts every fifteen minutes, its boiling mud able to burn a man's lower body away.

facts.fact: 邦德在11时14分喷发前起身，暴露自己听得懂英语，布洛菲尔德由此推断他是为复仇而来且未向任何人透露萨特汉的真实身份
facts.quote: It is indeed the same Britischer.
facts.fact_en: Bond rises from his seat just before the next eruption, betraying that he understands English; Blofeld concludes he has come for revenge and has told no one Shatterhand's true identity.

facts.fact: 邦德用长棍击昏艾玛·布朗特，与布洛菲尔德展开长棍对武士刀的搏斗，最终徒手扼死布洛菲尔德
facts.quote: Die, Blofeld! Die!
facts.fact_en: Bond knocks Irma Bunt out with his stave, fights Blofeld - staff against samurai sword - and finally strangles Blofeld with his bare hands.

facts.fact: 布洛菲尔德死前为自己辩护，称霹雳弹勒索、细菌战与死亡城堡都是天才之举与公共服务，并承认自己患上精神倦怠
facts.quote: I have come to suffer from a certain lassitude of mind
facts.fact_en: Before he dies, Blofeld defends himself, calling the Thunderball blackmail, the germ-warfare plot and the Castle of Death acts of genius and public service, and admitting he suffers from a lassitude of mind.

facts.fact: 邦德关闭间歇泉阀门后城堡爆炸，他抓住氢气球系绳逃生，升空后中弹坠海
facts.quote: a huge jet of orange fire shot up from hell towards the moon
facts.fact_en: Bond shuts the geyser valve and the castle explodes; he escapes by clinging to the mooring rope of a helium balloon, is shot as he rises, and falls into the sea.

facts.fact: M在讣告中写邦德生于苏格兰人格伦科的安德鲁·邦德与瑞士人莫妮克·德拉克罗瓦，11岁父母死于霞慕尼攀登事故，由姑妈查米安抚养，伊顿退学后转入费蒂斯，1941年谎称19岁入职，1954年授CMG勋章
facts.quote: James Bond was born of a Scottish father, Andrew Bond of Glencoe
facts.fact_en: In the obituary M writes that Bond was born to Andrew Bond of Glencoe in Scotland and Monique Delacroix of Switzerland, lost both parents in a climbing accident at Chamonix when he was eleven, was raised by his aunt Charmian, left Eton for Fettes, joined up in 1941 claiming to be nineteen, and was awarded the CMG in 1954.

facts.fact: M宣布邦德失踪、推定死亡，但其日本任务百分之百成功，王国安全得到巨大保证
facts.quote: the mission proved one hundred per cent successful.
facts.fact_en: M announces Bond missing and presumed dead, but declares his Japanese mission one hundred per cent successful and a great safeguard of the realm's security.

facts.fact: 讣告写邦德1962年与马赛人马克-安热·德拉科的独生女特蕾莎短暂结婚，婚姻无子女，邦德无在世亲属
facts.quote: James Bond was briefly married in 1962, to Teresa
facts.fact_en: The obituary records that Bond was briefly married in 1962 to Teresa, the only child of Marc-Ange Draco of Marseilles, that the marriage had no children, and that Bond leaves no living relatives.

facts.fact: 喜悦子在城墙下等候时救起坠海的邦德，邦德因头部受伤失忆，只记得一张死去男人的脸
facts.quote: Nothing except a man's face. I think he was dead.
facts.fact_en: Kissy, waiting below the castle wall, rescues Bond from the sea; a head injury has left him with amnesia, and all he remembers is the face of a dead man.

facts.fact: 黑岛医生诊断邦德颞叶记忆区受损，失忆可能持续数月甚至数年，需不断提醒过去的事物来恢复
facts.quote: It may be months, even years before he regains his memory.
facts.fact_en: The doctor of Kuro diagnoses damage to the temporal lobe, the seat of memory, and warns that the amnesia may last for months, even years, and that Bond must be constantly reminded of things from his past.

facts.fact: 喜悦子谎称邦德就是渔民塔罗·托多罗基、是她的恋人，神父默许全岛对搜查者装作一无所知，田中与迪科多次上岛寻找无果
facts.quote: You are my lover. Your name is Taro Todoroki.
facts.fact_en: Kissy claims Bond is the fisherman Taro Todoroki, her lover; the priest lets the whole island pretend to searchers that they know nothing, and Tanaka and Dikko search Kuro repeatedly without finding him.

facts.fact: 神父告诉喜悦子，魔鬼的后代已死，其妻亦死，死亡城堡已被彻底摧毁，预言由海外来人实现
facts.quote: The spawn of the devil is dead. So is his wife.
facts.fact_en: The priest tells Kissy that the spawn of the devil is dead, his wife with him, and the Castle of Death utterly destroyed, and that the prophecy of the man from overseas has been fulfilled.

facts.fact: 喜悦子在福冈性用品店花5000日元买蟾蜍汗与干蜥蜴粉，混入邦德的寿喜烧中，并用一本枕绘图册唤起邦德的性能力
facts.quote: Kissy, take off your clothes and lie down there.
facts.fact_en: Kissy spends 5,000 yen in a Fukuoka sex shop on toad sweat and dried lizard powder, mixes them into Bond's sukiyaki, and uses a book of pillow pictures to awaken his sexual appetite.

facts.fact: 喜悦子怀孕，盘算何时告诉邦德她要生孩子、邦德是否会向她求婚
facts.quote: she was going to have a baby
facts.fact_en: Kissy is pregnant, and wonders when to tell Bond that she is going to have a baby and whether he will ask her to marry him.

facts.fact: 邦德在厕纸上看到符拉迪沃斯托克一词，触动记忆，决定经北海道去萨哈林再到符拉迪沃斯托克寻回过去，喜悦子送他离岛
facts.quote: Kissy, what is this word Vladivostok?
facts.fact_en: Seeing the word Vladivostok on a scrap of toilet paper, Bond's memory stirs; he decides to travel by way of Hokkaido to Sakhalin and on to Vladivostok to recover his past, and Kissy sees him off the island.

facts.fact: 全书结尾邦德不知道自己名叫詹姆斯·邦德，黑岛生活在他眼中已如麻雀的眼泪般微不足道
facts.quote: he didn't know that his name was James Bond.
facts.fact_en: The novel ends with Bond not knowing that his name is James Bond, his life on Kuro already as little to him as sparrows' tears beside the blazing significance of that single Russian word.

facts.fact: 田中虎出生于虎年，邦德出生于鼠年，田中以此取笑邦德
facts.quote: Mr Tanaka had been born in the year of the Tiger
facts.fact_en: Tiger Tanaka was born in the Year of the Tiger, and Bond in the Year of the Rat, which Tanaka uses to tease him.

facts.fact: 邦德被田中称为邦多先生，因为詹姆斯在日语中难发音，而邦德先生易与和尚一词混淆
facts.quote: So you are Bondo-san.
facts.fact_en: Tanaka calls Bond Bondo-san, because James is hard to pronounce in Japanese and Mister Bond would be confused with the word for a priest.

facts.fact: 邦德在火车上被戴口罩、黑皮帽的男子偷走钱包，内有5000日元，后在黑龙会特工身上找回，分文未少
facts.quote: His wallet was gone.
facts.fact_en: On the train a man in a mask and a black leather cap steals Bond's wallet, which holds 5,000 yen; it is later recovered from the Black Dragon agent, intact to the last yen.

facts.fact: 田中派去死亡城堡的特工曾被布洛菲尔德关进审讯室折磨，尸体在海岸被发现时几乎完整，布洛菲尔德认为应扔进食人鱼湖处理
facts.quote: That spy we put through the Question Room.
facts.fact_en: Tanaka's agent sent to the Castle of Death had been tortured in the Question Room by Blofeld; when his body was found on the shore it was almost intact, and Blofeld thought it should have been thrown into the piranha lake.

locations.description_en: The house in Yokohama where Tanaka tells Bond about the collector of death and proposes the bargain.

locations.description_en: Blofeld's poison garden and castle, which Bond enters, fights in and destroys.

locations.description_en: The capital of Kyushu and Superintendent Ando's base, from which Bond sets out for Kuro Island.

locations.description_en: The hot-spring town where Bond and Tanaka tour the Ten Hells and eat a fugu dinner.

locations.role: 邦德与田中参观伊势神宫、神户牛肉产地与最古老妓院的中途站
locations.description_en: A staging post on the tour that takes in the shrine of Ise, Kobe beef and Japan's oldest brothel.

locations.description_en: The fishing port reached by hydrofoil, home of the pearl king Mikimoto.

locations.description_en: Bond's base, home of M's office and Blades club, and where the obituary is published.

locations.role: 田中考验邦德化装是否过关的神道神社
locations.description_en: The Shinto shrine where Tanaka tests whether Bond's disguise will pass.

mission.investigation: 邦德以澳大利亚外交官身份抵达东京，与迪科接头后会见田中，田中出示MAGIC44样本密电，邦德凭记忆传回伦敦；一个月后田中提出以刺杀换MAGIC44，邦德化装成日本渔民工人，经鸟羽、京都、别府一路受训后抵达福冈，认出萨特汉就是布洛菲尔德，住进黑岛等待满月夜游过海峡潜入城堡
key_clues: MAGIC44样本密电：200兆吨武器9月20日新地岛试爆
日本已渗透澳门蓝色通道，邦德无物可换
萨特汉博士夫妇1月入境，半年内500多人来死亡花园自杀
田中派去的特工被折磨致死，只念蜻蜓俳句

六尊地藏守护神预言海外来人杀死死亡之王
mission.objective: 从日本秘密情报首脑田中虎手中取得破译苏联密电的成果MAGIC44，不得让美国中央情报局知晓
mission.outcome: 邦德凭记忆传回MAGIC44样本密电，西方反制使苏联讹诈推迟；邦德潜入死亡城堡徒手扼死布洛菲尔德，城堡爆炸，邦德坠海失忆，伦敦方面推定其死亡，M在讣告中宣布任务百分之百成功

organizations.role: 布洛菲尔德创立的组织，全称反情报、恐怖主义、报复与勒索特别机构，本部中只在邦德回忆中提及，布洛菲尔德已脱离组织单干
organizations.description_en: The organisation founded by Blofeld, its full name the Special Executive for Counter-intelligence, Terrorism, Revenge and Extortion; in this novel it is mentioned only in Bond's memories, and Blofeld has left it to work alone.

organizations.role: 田中虎领导的日本秘密情报机构，掌控MAGIC44并负责对付死亡城堡
organizations.description_en: The Japanese secret intelligence service led by Tiger Tanaka, which controls MAGIC 44 and is charged with dealing with the Castle of Death.

organizations.role: 日本情报的实际控制方，不许田中把MAGIC44转交给英国，邦德的行动须瞒着它
organizations.description_en: The real power behind Japanese intelligence; it forbids Tanaka to hand MAGIC 44 to Britain, and Bond's approach must be kept from it.

organizations.role: 邦德所属机构，以国防部为掩护，M为首脑
organizations.description_en: The service Bond belongs to, fronted by the Ministry of Defence, with M at its head.

organizations.role: 迪科·亨德森领导的驻东京机构，为邦德提供外交掩护与通讯渠道
organizations.description_en: The Tokyo station led by Dikko Henderson, which gives Bond his diplomatic cover and his channel of communication.

organizations.role: 战前已解散的日本极端秘密会社，其余党约20人受雇为死亡城堡守卫，并派特工跟踪田中
organizations.description_en: A pre-war Japanese extremist secret society, officially disbanded; about twenty of its remaining members are hired as guards for the Castle of Death, and it sends an agent to tail Tanaka.

vehicles.description_en: The weekly mailboat between Kuro and Fukuoka; Kissy takes it to shop in Fukuoka, and Bond takes it when he leaves the island at last.

canon_vs_inference.note: 神父向喜悦子转述布洛菲尔德夫妇皆死、死亡城堡被彻底摧毁，属原文中人物转述的事实；艾玛·布朗特本人最后一次直接出场时只是被邦德用长棍击昏、仍在呼吸，爆炸中如何死亡原文未写明细节
canon_vs_inference.note_en: The priest tells Kissy that Blofeld and his wife are both dead and the Castle of Death utterly destroyed, which is fact as reported by a character in the novel; when Irma Bunt is last seen directly, Bond has only knocked her out with his stave and she is still breathing, and the novel never spells out how she dies in the explosion.

canon_vs_inference.note: 邦德失忆后喜悦子怀孕，原文只写她盘算何时告诉邦德她要生孩子，未写孩子是否出生、性别或后续
canon_vs_inference.note_en: After Bond loses his memory, Kissy becomes pregnant; the novel only says she wonders when to tell Bond she is going to have a baby, and never says whether the child is born, its sex, or what follows.

canon_vs_inference.note: 故事年份原文未直接写明，8月31日、9月20日核试验、10月潜水等月份日期出自原文，年份按出版年1964年与前作时间线推断为1963年秋至1964年春，标为推断
canon_vs_inference.note_en: The novel never states the year outright; the dates of 31 August, the 20 September test and the October diving come from the text, and the year is inferred as autumn 1963 to spring 1964 from the publication year 1964 and the timeline of the preceding novels, and is marked as inference.

canon_vs_inference.note: 邦德关闭间歇泉阀门后城堡爆炸，原文只写邦德关阀后逃离、随后城堡逐层崩塌并喷出巨大火柱，关阀与爆炸的因果为邦德行动与叙事顺序所支持的推断
canon_vs_inference.topic_en: The Cause of the Castle Explosion
canon_vs_inference.note_en: Bond shuts the geyser valve and the castle then explodes; the novel only says that after he shuts the valve and flees, the castle collapses floor by floor and a great column of fire shoots up, so the causal link between shutting the valve and the explosion is an inference supported by Bond's action and the order of events.

canon_vs_inference.note: 田中虎与M之间关于MAGIC44的最终交易是否兑现，原文讣告只写任务百分之百成功、王国安全得到巨大保证，未写日本是否正式移交MAGIC44全部内容
canon_vs_inference.topic_en: Whether MAGIC 44 Was Finally Handed Over
canon_vs_inference.note_en: Whether the final bargain over MAGIC 44 between Tanaka and M was ever honoured is not stated in the novel; the obituary only says the mission was one hundred per cent successful and the security of the realm greatly assured, without saying whether Japan formally handed over the whole of MAGIC 44.

synopsis_en: Eight months after the murder of his wife Tracy, James Bond is falling apart - drinking, gambling and making mistakes - and M is ready to pension him off. The neurologist Sir James Molony persuades M to give him one last chance: an apparently impossible mission in Japan. Bond must persuade Tiger Tanaka, head of the Japanese secret service, to hand over MAGIC 44, the product of Japan's decryption of Soviet traffic from Vladivostok, which the CIA forbids Tanaka to share with Britain. A sample decrypt reveals a Soviet 200-megaton weapon to be tested on 20 September, and Bond's memorised report of it helps the West blunt a Soviet blackmail attempt. But Tanaka's price for the full MAGIC 44 is murder: Bond must enter the Castle of Death on Kyushu and kill its master, Dr Guntram Shatterhand, a Swiss botanist who collects death and whose poison garden has already drawn more than five hundred suicides. Disguised as a deaf-mute Japanese coalminer, Bond trains his way across Japan to the island of Kuro, where he lodges with the ama diver Kissy Suzuki. On a moonlit night he swims to the castle, is captured, and recognises Shatterhand as his wife's murderer, Ernst Stavro Blofeld, with Irma Bunt at his side. Bond strangles Blofeld with his bare hands and destroys the castle, but falls into the sea and is presumed dead. M publishes his obituary, while Kissy, who has pulled the amnesiac Bond from the water, hides him on Kuro as the fisherman Taro Todoroki. Pregnant with his child, she watches him sail away the following spring when the word Vladivostok stirs his lost memory - the novel ending before he learns that his name is James Bond.

mission_en.objective_en: To obtain MAGIC 44, the Japanese decryption of Soviet traffic, from Tiger Tanaka, head of the Japanese secret service, without the CIA learning of it.
mission_en.investigation_en: Bond arrives in Tokyo under Australian diplomatic cover, meets Henderson, then Tanaka, who shows him a sample MAGIC 44 decrypt that Bond memorises and sends to London; a month later Tanaka offers MAGIC 44 in exchange for an assassination, and Bond, disguised as a Japanese fisherman-labourer, trains his way through Toba, Kyoto and Beppu to Fukuoka, recognises Shatterhand as Blofeld, lodges on Kuro Island and, on a moonlit night, swims across the strait to enter the castle.
key_clues_en: The sample MAGIC 44 decrypt: a 200-megaton weapon to be tested at Novaya Zemlya on 20 September.
Japan has already penetrated the Macao Blue Route, so Bond has nothing to trade.
Dr Shatterhand and his wife entered Japan in January; more than five hundred people have come to the garden of death to kill themselves in six months.
Tanaka's agent sent to the castle was tortured to death, dying with a haiku about dragonflies on his lips.
Passport photographs reveal Shatterhand as Blofeld and his wife as Irma Bunt.
The six stone Jizo guardians prophesy that a man from overseas will kill the King of Death.
mission_en.outcome_en: Bond memorised the sample MAGIC 44 decrypt and sent it to London, where the Western response postponed the Soviet blackmail; he entered the Castle of Death, strangled Blofeld with his bare hands and the castle exploded, but Bond fell into the sea an amnesiac and London presumed him dead, M declaring the mission one hundred per cent successful in his obituary.
